decisions.reason: This bleaching tray blank line fits the firm's dental laboratory materials portfolio and, having remained visible after launch, is likely a viable complementary product worth retaining.
The PETG thermoforming blank supports the company's core dental thermoforming workflow and should stay in the range unless demand proves structurally weak.
The UV-curing lacquer is a smaller accessory-type material with somewhat higher pruning risk, but it still aligns well with the firm's custom-device manufacturing and finishing expertise.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are close to the firm's hearing-care business and customization strengths, so management would most likely continue the line.
